title: Silas and the Extraction
author: Vesper Coldharbour
blurb: Ansel Hartwell, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. But when the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident before the summit convenes.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
